ModMetaData.name: RimThreaded Overclocked
ModMetaData.author: DrPepper; original RimThreaded by Major Hoff
ModMetaData.description:
RimThreaded Overclocked enables RimWorld to utilize multiple threads and thus greatly increases the speed of the game.
UNOFFICIAL continuation of RimThreaded for RimWorld 1.6 and 1.7, by DrPepper. This is its own mod (packageId drpepper.rimthreaded.overclocked): do not run it together with the original RimThreaded (majorhoff.rimthreaded). A mod list or save that names the original RimThreaded needs this mod switched on once by hand. Based on RimThreaded by Caleb Seelhoff (Major Hoff), MIT license, and on the 1.6 port by kazenokizu (Nolo). Not made or supported by the original author or by the 1.6 port: please report problems here, not to them. -Based on RimThreaded 2.7.2 (RimWorld 1.4) -1.7 (Waylith engine, .NET 10): built against 1.7.5000 rev1275; tested in unattended in-game runs with ~1,300 popular mods -1.6: built against 1.6.4871 rev590; tested in the same unattended in-game runs -Experimental: back up saves.
SETTINGS: The number of threads to utilize should be set in the mod settings, according to your specific computer's core count. If you are experiencing "Thread Timeout" errors, try increasing your Thread Abort Timeout threshold.
TICK PROFILER (this port): Mod settings > RimThreaded Overclocked > Tick profiler > Start measuring (or dev mode > debug actions > RimThreaded). Measures where each tick's time goes: tick steps, worker threads, kinds of thing, game systems, and every mod's patches. Reports are saved in your RimWorld save-data folder under RimThreaded\Profiles.
LOAD ORDER: Put RimThreaded Overclocked last in load order.
BUG REPORTS (this port): Mod settings > RimThreaded Overclocked > Report a problem. It builds a short report (PC specs, mod list, errors, your user name removed) that you can check before sending. Send it with the form at https://github.com/DrPeppere/rimthreaded-issues or in the pinned "Bug reports" discussion on the Workshop page.
